description.value: Cathedral Mountain Lodge is a collection of handcrafted luxury log cabins set along the Kicking Horse River inside Yoho National Park, near Emerald Lake and Field, BC. Designed by Vancouver architect Brad Lamoureux and opened in 2006, the lodge uses native logs, timber framing, and local stone to blend into its forested riverside setting. Guests enjoy chef-driven fine dining in the on-site Riverside Dining Room and complimentary concierge services, making it a high-end staging point for exploring iconic Rockies destinations such as Lake Louise, Takakkaw Falls, and the Burgess Shale.
